slots.intent: Read what the user asked for, in their own words, from this conversation. That is what they want built.
slots.ask: Ask with this host's own question tool — the one question, the option labels only — and pass `decide` exactly the option they picked. For a brief or a merge, ask a yes and a no the same way and call `approve` or `accept` with `confirmed: true` only on an explicit yes. Never answer on their behalf, and never treat a reply you did not get as one.
slots.spawn-guard: **The block does not reach into this session here.** SOBER's Claude Code plugin installs a hook that denies an agent spawn onto a held node. This host gets no such hook, so SOBER can tell you the rule and cannot enforce it — which makes keeping it yours. Never spawn an agent onto a node the board holds, and never route around a decision because nothing stopped you. Say what is held and answer it instead.
